description: This Java class, IntegrationModulesLoader, is responsible for loading and parsing JSON configuration files related to integration modules. It reads JSON data, maps it to Java objects such as IntegrationModule and ModuleConfig, and provides methods to load modules with detailed configuration data. The class is annotated with @Component, indicating it's a Spring-managed bean within the application's context.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for loading and parsing JSON configuration files into IntegrationModule objects, including handling nested configurations and regions.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Reads a JSON file from the classpath given its path, deserializes it into an array of Map objects, and converts each Map into an IntegrationModule instance.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Constructs an IntegrationModule object from a Map representing JSON data, handling various fields such as module name, code, image, type, customModule, details, configuration, and regions.
